snippet.title: Saint Slayer Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege is releasing on PS4, PS5, Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series and Xbox One April 20th 2026!
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3695650/Saint_Slayer_Spear_of_Sacrilege/

Trailer by Lachlan Pini & Mel Rouen
